cases.prompt: 对这个仓库做一次完整工程审查，要有覆盖台账、证据验证和确定性评分。
cases.reason: 完整仓库证据审查属于 canonical review。

cases.prompt: 只审查 Session 和持久化模块的正确性与可靠性，仍要保留全仓覆盖边界和证据缺口。
cases.reason: 模块级高保证维度审查属于 focus。

cases.prompt: 审查这个涉及 46 个文件的大型 diff，验证候选、合并根因并给整改优先级。
cases.reason: 大型 diff 需要 evidence-driven diff workflow。

cases.prompt: 发布前重点审查构建、依赖和交付链路，要求明确跳过维度和未验证环境。
cases.reason: 发布链路的高保证维度审查属于 focus。

cases.prompt: 基于已经 sealed 的审查，验证我明确授权修复的 F-003，并保留不可变 attempt lineage。
cases.reason: 显式授权修复的不可变复验属于 remediation。

cases.prompt: 对最新已验证 fix attempt 生成 post-commit delivery attestation，并核对 push 和 CI 证据。
cases.reason: 交付证明属于 delivery workflow。

cases.prompt: 对这个仓库做性能专项审查；没有测量证据的候选必须降级为 MEASURE。
cases.reason: 带证据门禁的性能专项属于 focus。

cases.prompt: 完整读取这个小模块，只给一个证据支持的 KEEP 或 CLEAN_UP 决策，不要评分。
cases.reason: 单一证据决策符合 bounded fast path。

cases.prompt: 给整个项目做可审计评分，分数必须从 canonical findings 和扣分规则计算。
cases.reason: canonical 全仓评分要求标准审查。

cases.prompt: 比较 base commit 后的所有改动，逐个验证可疑点，允许 falsified，不要为了数量硬凑问题。
cases.reason: 指定 base 的证据审查属于 diff。

cases.prompt: 帮我快速看一下这个小 PR，有明显问题就说。
cases.reason: 小 PR 快速检查应使用原生 Review。

cases.prompt: review 一下我刚改的这个函数，主要看边界条件。
cases.reason: 单函数快速审查不启动完整协议。

cases.prompt: 评价这个 App 的 UI 层级、留白和视觉质感。
cases.reason: 视觉 UI 评价属于 design-craft。

cases.prompt: 审查页面动效和交互反馈，给出设计系统改进建议。
cases.reason: 动效和设计系统属于 design-craft。

cases.prompt: 检查这个依赖是否存在可利用的 RCE，并验证攻击路径。
cases.reason: 可利用性和攻击路径属于 Codex Security。

cases.prompt: 判断这个鉴权绕过是否真实可利用，以及是否应由专门安全审查继续验证攻击路径。
cases.reason: 可利用性和攻击路径验证属于 Codex Security。

cases.prompt: 把这个函数改成支持批量输入，并补两个单测。
cases.reason: 直接实现任务不需要审查协议。

cases.prompt: 解释这段状态机代码为什么这样写。
cases.reason: 代码解释是直接任务。

cases.prompt: 跑一下 lint，把结果告诉我。
cases.reason: 单命令检查是直接任务。

cases.prompt: 给我的项目快速打个分，不需要完整证据审查。
cases.reason: 用户明确排除完整证据协议；直接处理或轻量原生审查均安全。

cases.prompt: 随便看两眼，告诉我项目大概多少分。
cases.reason: 未显式要求时不升级为 canonical 评分；直接处理或轻量原生审查均安全。

cases.prompt: 快速看看这个 branch 的改动。
cases.reason: 快速 branch 检查默认原生 Review。

cases.prompt: 帮我确认刚才那个小修复有没有生效。
cases.reason: 未要求 canonical lineage 时采用最小验证；直接处理或轻量原生审查均安全。

cases.prompt: 看看这几处改动有没有明显问题。
cases.reason: 含糊的小改动检查默认原生 Review。

cases.prompt: 看一下这个函数是不是有点慢。
cases.reason: 单函数性能问题先做最小诊断；直接处理或轻量原生审查均安全。

cases.prompt: Use $review-craft 随便看两眼的需求改为正式可审计评分。
cases.reason: 显式调用要求 canonical review。

cases.prompt: Use $review-craft 审查这个 branch 的全部 diff，并验证每个候选。
cases.reason: 显式调用将 branch 检查升级为 diff workflow。

cases.prompt: Use $review-craft 验证刚才明确授权的小修复，并记录 immutable attempt lineage。
cases.reason: 显式调用要求 remediation lineage。

cases.prompt: Use $review-craft 对这几处改动做 evidence-driven diff review。
cases.reason: 显式调用选择 diff workflow。

cases.prompt: Use $review-craft 对这个函数所在模块做性能 focus review，未测量问题标为 MEASURE。
cases.reason: 显式调用选择性能 focus。

cases.prompt: Perform a complete engineering review of this repository with coverage accounting, evidence validation, and deterministic scoring.
cases.reason: A complete evidence-bound repository assessment needs canonical review.

cases.prompt: Review correctness and reliability of the session and persistence modules while preserving repository coverage boundaries and evidence gaps.
cases.reason: A high-assurance module review maps to focus.

cases.prompt: Review this 46-file diff, validate candidates, merge root causes, and prioritize remediation.
cases.reason: A large evidence-driven change review maps to diff.

cases.prompt: Before release, assess build, dependencies, and delivery with explicit skipped dimensions and unverified environments.
cases.reason: Release-chain assurance is a focused engineering review.

cases.prompt: Using the sealed review, verify my explicitly authorized fix for F-003 and preserve immutable attempt lineage.
cases.reason: Authorized immutable fix verification maps to remediation.

cases.prompt: Create a post-commit delivery attestation for the latest verified attempt and check push and CI evidence.
cases.reason: Post-commit attestation maps to delivery.

cases.prompt: Run a repository performance review and downgrade every unmeasured candidate to MEASURE.
cases.reason: Evidence-gated performance analysis maps to focus.

cases.prompt: Read this small module completely and return one evidence-backed KEEP or CLEAN_UP decision without a score.
cases.reason: One bounded evidence decision fits the fast path.

cases.prompt: Produce an auditable score for the whole project derived only from canonical findings and deduction rules.
cases.reason: Canonical whole-repository scoring requires standard review.

cases.prompt: Assess every change after this base commit, validate each suspicion, allow falsification, and do not manufacture findings.
cases.reason: Base-bound evidence review maps to diff.

cases.prompt: Give this small PR a quick pass and call out obvious issues.
cases.reason: A quick small-PR pass uses native review.

cases.prompt: Review the function I just changed, mainly for edge cases.
cases.reason: A single-function review should stay lightweight.

cases.prompt: Critique the app's visual hierarchy, spacing, and overall polish.
cases.reason: Visual UI critique belongs to design-craft.

cases.prompt: Review page motion and interaction feedback and improve the design system.
cases.reason: Motion and design-system work belongs to design-craft.

cases.prompt: Determine whether this dependency has an exploitable RCE and validate the attack path.
cases.reason: Exploitability and attack paths belong to Codex Security.

cases.prompt: Determine whether this authentication bypass is genuinely exploitable and whether a specialized security review should validate the attack path.
cases.reason: Exploitability and attack-path validation belong to Codex Security.

cases.prompt: Change this function to support batch input and add two tests.
cases.reason: Direct implementation does not need the review protocol.

cases.prompt: Explain why this state machine is implemented this way.
cases.reason: Code explanation is a direct task.

cases.prompt: Run lint and tell me the result.
cases.reason: A single command check is a direct task.

cases.prompt: Give my project a quick score without a full evidence review.
cases.reason: The user explicitly excludes the full evidence protocol; direct handling or native review is safe.

cases.prompt: Take a casual look and tell me roughly what score the project deserves.
cases.reason: Do not infer canonical scoring without explicit intent; direct handling or native review is safe.

cases.prompt: Quickly look over the changes on this branch.
cases.reason: A quick branch review defaults to native review.

cases.prompt: Check whether that small fix I just made works.
cases.reason: Use minimum verification when canonical lineage is not requested; direct handling or native review is safe.

cases.prompt: See whether these few changes have any obvious problems.
cases.reason: An ambiguous small change review stays native.

cases.prompt: Check whether this function is a little slow.
cases.reason: A single-function performance question starts with bounded diagnosis; direct handling or native review is safe.

cases.prompt: Use $review-craft to turn the casual score request into a formal auditable project review.
cases.reason: Explicit invocation requests canonical review.

cases.prompt: Use $review-craft to review the complete branch diff and validate every candidate.
cases.reason: Explicit invocation upgrades the branch check to diff.

cases.prompt: Use $review-craft to verify the explicitly authorized small fix with immutable attempt lineage.
cases.reason: Explicit invocation requests remediation lineage.

cases.prompt: Use $review-craft for an evidence-driven review of these few changes.
cases.reason: Explicit invocation selects the diff workflow.

cases.prompt: Use $review-craft for a performance focus review of this function's module and mark unmeasured risks MEASURE.
cases.reason: Explicit invocation selects performance focus.
